Integration should confirm that the provider and coordinator canonicalizers, which are not supplied here, apply enable_thinking consistently when computing prompt_contract_id and block hashes. A divergence would be a correctness or cache-hit issue, not cross-tenant leakage, because hashing remains scope-keyed (scope_id fixture-scope).
